latest_candidates.minimum_change: Map and reduce mutation paths; designate one current authority and route all other writers through a deterministic broker or read-only projection.
latest_candidates.proposal: More than one mutable current authority surface exists without one verified effect broker
latest_candidates.rationale: The archive repeatedly shows canonical runtime, sibling package repository, direct CLI paths, swarm_sync, bridges and nested repositories competing for authority.
latest_candidates.regression_case: Multiple current mutable writers without one verified broker must block Unified Canonical State and implementation promotion.
latest_candidates.rollback: Do not promote the candidate; preserve the prior accepted version.

latest_candidates.minimum_change: Bind every count to one universe and publish a disjoint/overlap matrix before using the figures in a verdict.
latest_candidates.proposal: Declared numerical partition does not reconcile to its total
latest_candidates.rationale: Archive reports can be broadly correct while mixing copied representatives, duplicate occurrences and excluded candidates into one invalid sum.
latest_candidates.regression_case: A disjoint partition whose component sum differs from its declared total must fail the report admission gate.
latest_candidates.rollback: Do not promote the candidate; preserve the prior accepted version.

latest_candidates.minimum_change: Attach universe_id, denominator, subset relation and overlap semantics to every quantitative claim.
latest_candidates.proposal: Counts from different universes or subsets were compared as one partition
latest_candidates.rationale: The checkpoint audit reports 327 evidenced across 970 records and 551 claimed inside a 787-record strong-progress subset; these are not one direct partition.
latest_candidates.regression_case: A count over all ledger records must not be subtracted from a strong-progress subset without an explicit crosswalk.
latest_candidates.rollback: Do not promote the candidate; preserve the prior accepted version.

latest_candidates.minimum_change: Require proof_id, evidence family/source hash, verification method, status, timestamp and optional signature/readback fields.
latest_candidates.proposal: A ledger called proof lacks machine-verifiable proof identity fields
latest_candidates.rationale: The July meta-audit inspected 233 proof records and found none of these machine-verifiable fields.
latest_candidates.regression_case: A proof ledger with zero proof IDs, hashes, signatures and statuses must be classified as narrative evidence debt.
latest_candidates.rollback: Do not promote the candidate; preserve the prior accepted version.

latest_candidates.minimum_change: Keep architecture/canon status separate from implementation evidence, Git baseline, tests and target readback.
latest_candidates.proposal: A coherent specification was promoted as current implementation
latest_candidates.rationale: BitEvo canon contains strong event-log and governed-memory rules, while MAIN-033 still finds no root Git baseline and unresolved state identity.
latest_candidates.regression_case: Unified Canonical State or Truth Kernel language without current implementation receipts must remain a design candidate.
latest_candidates.rollback: Do not promote the candidate; preserve the prior accepted version.
